updateTime.description: Timestamp of the last update of this document

reportName.description: Name of the source report the document was ingested from

mission.description: Mission the satellite belongs to (e.g. S1, S2, S3, S5)

delivery_bitrate.description: Computed delivery bitrate of the acquisition pass

doy.description: Day of year of the acquisition pass

downlink_orbit.description: Downlink orbit number of the acquisition pass

antenna_id.description: Identifier of the antenna used for the acquisition

antenna_status.description: Status of the antenna during the acquisition pass

front_end_id.description: Identifier of the front-end used for the acquisition

front_end_status.description: Status of the front-end during the acquisition pass

planned_data_start.description: Planned start time of the data acquisition

planned_data_stop.description: Planned stop time of the data acquisition

first_frame_start.description: Start time of the first acquired frame

last_frame_stop.description: Stop time of the last acquired frame

delivery_push_status.description: Status of the delivery push step of the acquisition pass

start_delivery.description: Start time of the data delivery

stop_delivery.description: Stop time of the data delivery

number_of_chunks.description: Number of chunks in the acquisition pass

overall_data_volume.description: Overall acquired data volume of the acquisition pass

overall_number_of_bad_downlinked_frames.description: Overall number of bad downlinked frames

fer_downlink.description: Frame error rate of the downlink

overall_number_of_data_acquired_frames.description: Overall number of acquired data frames

overall_number_of_bad_data_acquired_fram.description: Overall number of bad acquired data frames

fer_data.description: Frame error rate of the data

notes.description: Free-text notes about the acquisition pass

cams_tickets.description: Identifiers of the CAMS tickets linked to this acquisition pass

last_attached_ticket.description: Identifier of the last CAMS ticket attached to this acquisition pass

last_attached_ticket_url.description: URL of the last CAMS ticket attached to this acquisition pass

cams_origin.description: Origin of the linked CAMS ticket(s)

cams_description.description: Description of the linked CAMS ticket(s)

ground_station.description: Ground station where the acquisition pass was performed

from_acq_delivery_timeliness.description: Timeliness between acquisition and delivery, computed from first_frame_start to stop_delivery

report_type.description: Type of the source report (daily, weekly or monthly)

report_name_daily.description: Name of the daily source report the document was ingested from

report_name_weekly.description: Name of the weekly source report the document was ingested from

report_name_monthly.description: Name of the monthly source report the document was ingested from
